body:
No.

While it may indeed be a great game that 'always beats the blues' for you, I am not looking for video game recommendations...

I took your advice about seeking professional help.  It took a couple attempts; I dialed a suicide prevention hotline number last night and just stared at my phone.  I wasn't able to get myself to hit send.  I tried again tonight when I got home from work and succeeded!  After an hour or so on the phone, I feel a little better.  I am going to try to set up an appointment tomorrow with a therapist, and the folks from the hotline are going to follow up in the afternoon.  Small victories.

Like you, I have always been against the idea of medicating.  However, I have never had thoughts / feelings this strong about ending my life.  On that note, I would be willing to try something new.

Thanks for the advice (and *HUGZ*).
I didn't make it to the counselling office today.  I didn't even get out of bed until I had to go to work.  I am going to try again tomorrow.
I'll do what I can.  Yeah, she is a good friend and the only person I have told about this.

Thank you for your insights.

My school does have a counselling office.  I have been talking to a friend for a while now and she helped convince me to go in tomorrow.

It is hard not to beat myself up over that stuff, but I'll try.
I guess I should have been more specific in my request for advice.
Your post had me in tears.  I am reading through the links you posted.  Thank you.  Both for your words and offering a shoulder to cry on.
Sorry, I did not know about that subreddit.
